title: CAppleNet: A Coordinate Attention-Based YOLO11 for Real-Time Apple Stem Cavity and Calyx Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.13920v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated fruit grading, sorting, and orientation systems require real-time, accurate detection of fruit-level morphological landmarks rather than the fruit boundary alone. This paper presents a custom, fully self-collected and self-annotated dataset of 1506 apple images (1054 training, 301 validation, 151 test) captured under controlled, fixed-camera conditions and annotated for three target classes: fruit body, stem cavity, and calyx. A YOLO11s detector trained with default hyperparameters is adopted as the baseline, and a systematic, one-factor-at-a-time ablation study is conducted across input resolution, data augmentation policy, optimizer configuration, and lightweight architectural enhancement to identify the factors that most improve detection of these fine-grained landmarks under high inter-cultivar color and texture variability. translated_title: CAppleNet：基于坐标注意力的YOLO11用于苹果果梗凹陷与花萼的实时检测
translated_abstract: 自动化水果分级、分拣和定向系统需要对水果级形态标志点（而不仅仅是水果边界）进行实时、准确的检测。本文提出了一个完全自采自标注的数据集，包含1506张苹果图像（1054张训练、301张验证、151张测试），这些图像在受控的固定相机条件下采集，并针对三个目标类别进行了标注：果实本体、果梗凹陷（萼洼）和花萼。研究采用默认超参数训练的YOLO11s检测器作为基线，并开展了系统性的单因素消融实验，涵盖输入分辨率、数据增强策略、优化器配置和轻量化架构增强等方面，以找出在品种间颜色和纹理高度差异的条件下，最能改善这些细粒度标志点检测效果的关键因素。实验表明，无论是提高输入分辨率，还是测试的六种数据增强变体，抑或是手动调整优化器参数，都未能……（原摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了CAppleNet，一种基于坐标注意力增强的YOLO11模型，在自建的1506张苹果图像数据集上实现了果梗凹陷与花萼等细粒度形态标志点的实时高精度检测，并通过系统性消融实验确定了关键改进因素。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CAppleNet, a coordinate attention-enhanced YOLO11 model that achieves real-time detection of fine-grained apple morphological landmarks (stem cavity and calyx) on a self-collected dataset of 1506 apple images, with a systematic ablation study identifying the key factors for improved detection.
